name: timebraid
description: Tracks the time of every Claude Code thread in Timebraid, in the right workspace and project, and lets Claude log time and read your totals.

api_token.title: Timebraid token
api_token.description: A token from Timebraid, Settings, Account, AI assistants. It starts with tally_mcp_ and reaches only the workspaces you belong to.

api_url.title: Timebraid server
api_url.description: The Timebraid API address. Leave the default unless you run your own server.
